title: Stock valuation CSV extract (FL-047)
requirement: STKVALF writes the extract VAL-REC 220 bytes line sequential: header ITEM,SITE,WAREHOUSE,LOCATION,LOT,OWNER,CONDITION,QTY,UNITCOST,VALUE,COSTSOURCE then one comma-separated line per listed bucket (qty 3 dp, cost 4 dp, value 2 dp); the never-cleared line buffer leaves the tail of a longer earlier line in a shorter one; reproduced byte for byte.
acceptance_criteria: The extract header equals the legacy header; for a shorter second line the record carries the tail characters of the first line exactly as the legacy file; byte comparison with the legacy extract after timestamp normalization

title: Lot and serial traceability report (LOTTRACE; ITM.LOTTRACE)
requirement: Job LOTTRACE reproduces LOTTRACE.cob: CO, SITE, USER, MODE, ASAT, ITEM, LOT, SERIAL with defaults CO=STC, USER=QA1, MODE=BOTH, ASAT host date; RC 8 E-0101/E-0102 for missing identity or item; banner from LOTSER EXPCHK; movements from LOTSER TRACE (at most 25) classified Quality, Forward or Backward with MODE print filters; RC 12 E-1001 when TRACE fails (including no movements); exit 0, 4, 8, 12; FROM and TO have no effect.
acceptance_criteria: An existing lot prints banner and movements with in and out totals over every movement; a lot without movements ends RC 12 STERP-E-1001 with no report; MODE=FORWARD hides backward lines but keeps totals; missing ITEM ends RC 8 E-0102

title: Stock count sheet, entry, approval and adjustment (COUNTADJ; ITM.COUNTADJ)
requirement: Job COUNTADJ reproduces COUNTADJ.cob with the program argument domain (CO, SITE, USER, MODE SHEET/ENTER/RECOUNT/APPROVE/POST, REF, WH, ITEM, LINE, QTY; defaults CO=STC, USER=WHSE, MODE=SHEET): SHEET opens a count and snapshots lines with the COUNTSHT spool; ENTER/RECOUNT store quantities with intervening movements; APPROVE refuses the counter with RC 4 W-3003; POST adjusts through STKMOVE ADJUST, ends after the first marked line and closes the count POSTED; any other MODE including PREVIEW/COMMIT from the page and catalogue ends RC 8 STERP-E-0001 and COUNT is never read.
acceptance_criteria: MODE=SHEET SITE=RDG creates an OPEN count with lines and a COUNTSHT spool; ENTER then APPROVE by the same USER gives RC 4 W-3003 and status stays COUNTED; POST of an approved count with three postable lines adjusts only the first and sets POSTED; MODE=PREVIEW COUNT=<ref> ends RC 8 STERP-E-0001 and the page shows COUNTADJ preview finished with return code 8.

title: Compliance and packaging report (PKGRPT; RPT-019)
requirement: Job PKGRPT reproduces PKGRPT.cob: CO, USER, MODE, ITEM, FROM, TO with defaults CO=STC, USER=COMPLY1, MODE=ALL, TO today, FROM 1 January; FROM after TO RC 8 E-0101; items capped at 500 (RC 4 W-1002); VATCODE, CUSTOMS, COMPLY, despatched quantity and PACKAGE per item through ITMCOMPL; MODE=DG/FAULTS print filters; kg totals ROUNDED 3 dp; RC 4 when any fault; exit 0, 4, 8, 12.
acceptance_criteria: STC FROM=20260101 TO=20261031 prints every non-retired item with VAT column as returned by VATCODE (---- while it fails), customs or none held, compliance fields and packaging grams for the despatched quantity; the run ends RC 4 when any fault was noted; FROM after TO ends RC 8 without spool

title: Opening stock load (OPENSTK; ITM.OPENSTK)
requirement: Job OPENSTK reproduces OPENSTK.cob: CO, SITE, USER, MODE, ASAT, IN with defaults CO=STC, USER=STKACCT, MODE=PREVIEW, ASAT today and input EXTRACTS/OPENSTK-<CO>.csv; MODE other than PREVIEW/COMMIT RC 8 STERP-E-0101; row validation OPN0001-OPN0006; PREVIEW lists valid rows as OPN0007 without posting; COMMIT posts STKMOVE OPENING per row with the per-row correlation id, RC below 8 counted as posted, duplicates listed OPN0008, RC 8+ rejected with STKMOVE reason; RC 4 when any row rejected or previewed; no batch unit of work.
acceptance_criteria: A file with three valid rows and one row without location gives in PREVIEW three OPN0007 and one OPN0002 with RC 4 and no posting; COMMIT posts three OPENING movements; a second COMMIT lists them as OPN0008 and posts nothing; MODE=TEST ends RC 8 STERP-E-0101

title: Opening stock load file (FL-043)
requirement: OPENSTK input LOAD-REC 300 bytes line sequential: every physical record counts as read; blank records, records starting * and records whose first four characters are ITEM are skipped; data rows split on commas without quote handling into item, site, warehouse, location, lot, serial, condition, quantity, UOM, unit cost, expiry, owner type, owner code, reference; defaults site from SITE, condition ACCEPTED, owner OWNED; expiry accepted numerically within 19000101-29991231.
acceptance_criteria: A row whose item starts with ITEM is skipped as a header; a quoted field containing a comma is split at the comma; an expiry 20260230 passes the range test; a blank row is counted as read but not processed

title: Item and Part Maintenance page (frmItemMaster)
requirement: page:itm/item-master reproduces frmItemMaster: item code box, Find (F2) with the PLATFORM lookup ITM.ITEM, caption line, nine read-only tabs loaded on demand, F5 load with not-found message, status with lifecycle and steward, F10 activation review binding the faults to the first grid.
acceptance_criteria: Ctrl+I opens the page; nut-m6-nyloc and F5 shows the NUT-M6-NYLOC caption; changing tab loads only that tab; F10 on an incomplete item shows the faults in the Revisions grid and the error dialog with Reason code: ITM0004

title: Stock Enquiry page (frmStockEnquiry)
requirement: page:itm/stock-enquiry reproduces frmStockEnquiry: filters item, site (session default) and condition, tools Availability (F10), Movements (180 days) and Lot trace, the six-quantity status line and the legacy warnings.
acceptance_criteria: As WHSE at STC/RDG Ctrl+K item NUT-M6-NYLOC F5 lists the QUAR01 quarantine bucket as not eligible; F10 shows the status line with the quarantine quantity excluded from free; Lot trace without a selected lot or serial warns Select a lot or serial row first.; at CAL/LIV CAL-BIKE-GRAVEL-M lists 0 record(s)

title: Stock Movement Entry page (frmStockMovement)
requirement: page:itm/stock-movement reproduces frmStockMovement: movement picker (RECEIPT ISSUE RETURN ADJUST SCRAP COMPLETE TRANSFER HOLD RELEASE), transit tick, 17 boxes with legacy captions and defaults, 90-day history grid, F2 lookup, F10 post with required-field warning and confirmation, success status with movement id and balance.
acceptance_criteria: F10 with an empty quantity shows An item code and a quantity are required. and calls nothing; a confirmed ISSUE shows Movement <id> posted; balance now <qty> <unit>.; a double F10 sends one Idempotency-Key and posts once; a RELEASE shows Reason code: STK0014

title: Stock Count and Adjustment page (frmStockCount)
requirement: page:itm/stock-count reproduces frmStockCount: filters count reference and status, tools Enter count (F10), Count sheet and Approve adjustment; counts or lines listing; counted-quantity prompt; COUNTADJ submissions with MODE PREVIEW or COMMIT and the return-code status message.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a line, F10 and 58 records 58 and reloads; Enter count without a selected line warns Select a count line first.; Count sheet without a reference warns Enter the count reference first.; Count sheet with a reference ends with return code 8 and cue *** ERROR

title: Debtors data contract (schema ar consumed as is)
requirement: The target consumes the 28 objects of schema ar exactly as defined in the repository (16 tables, 1 index, 1 function, 3 views, 5 procedures, 2 triggers): no DDL, procedures called with the legacy parameter names, triggers firing for target writes as for legacy writes; writes to other schemas only through the platform kernel and posting gateway (spec 3.1, 8).
acceptance_criteria: the drift check on /health/ready finds all 28 ar objects with repository columns, types and parameters;each target write to ar.CustomerCredit or ar.Customer produces exactly one trigger audit row with the legacy attribution rule;the target source contains no DDL against the shared database

title: Debtors menu rows and page routing
requirement: The 14 AR menu rows read at run time through core.usp_UiMenuLoad route to the four AR pages (frmCreditOverride twice: approval mode and REQUEST mode under Sales), to the platform generic maintenance (AR.CREDIT, AR.DDMANDATE) and to the platform report launcher (six report codes), honouring FormArgument and one window per class and argument; Shortcut values F5/F6/F7 are display text only (spec 3.1).
acceptance_criteria: for each demo user the Debtors rows equal core.usp_UiMenuLoad output in SortOrder with the legacy captions;SALESREP sees Sales > Request Credit Override and not Debtors > Credit Overrides;report rows open the launcher primed with the ReportCode;F5 inside an AR page refreshes the page and does not open Customer Enquiry;the two frmCreditOverride rows open two separate windows

title: Customer enquiry read (five panels)
requirement: ar_getCustomerEnquiry returns the five result sets of ar.usp_CustomerEnquiry called with @CompanyCode, @CustomerCode and @UserCode (balance row, six aged buckets, 12-month turnover/DSO to the server date with DSO null without credit sales, up to 500 open items, collection history); THROW 50301/50302 become 422 E-0301/E-0302 (spec 3.2).
acceptance_criteria: C0001 returns six aged buckets 0-5 and open item SI-26-1001;a user without AR.ENQUIRY gets 422 E-0301;an unknown customer gets 422 E-0302;no credit sales gives turnover.dsoDays null

title: Customer account list (F2 lookup)
requirement: ar_listCustomers runs the legacy picker SQL over ar.vw_CustomerBalance (code prefix or legal-name contains, ordered by code; empty search = NULL = all) through the generic lookup parameters, with no business permission check (spec 3.2).
acceptance_criteria: search C00 returns the matching customers ordered by code with count;empty or absent search returns every customer of the company without paging

title: Customer trading metrics (ARENQ METRICS)
requirement: ar_getCustomerMetrics links ARENQ METRICS with the as-at date and the 12 months before it: validation RC 08 ENQ0001-0003, AR.CUSTOMER.ENQUIRE refusal RC 06 ENQ0004 (no figures), unknown customer RC 16 ENQ0010, as-at balance and ageing, exposure/utilisation (RC 04 ENQ0021/ENQ0020), turnover, receipts, disputes, average days to pay and DSO (undefined, RC 04 ENQ0030, without positive credit sales) (spec 3.2, 4.8).
acceptance_criteria: the envelope data equals the legacy ARENQ COMMAREA for the same customer and as-at date;a user without AR.CUSTOMER.ENQUIRE gets 202 HOLD ENQ0004;unknown customer gets 404 ENQ0010;no credit sales gives dsoDefined N, dso 0.00 and RC 04 ENQ0030

title: Open-item statement lines
requirement: ar_getCustomerStatementLines calls ar.usp_CustomerStatementLines with @CompanyCode, @CustomerCode, @AsOf and @Style and no @UserCode (no permission check, as the facade), returning the header (opening, closing, movement, overdue, credits rebuilt by ar.fn_OpenItemAsOf) and the OPENITEM or TRANSACTION lines (spec 3.2).
acceptance_criteria: lines equal the procedure result set in document date and number order;the last running balance equals header.closingGbp;style OTHER gives 422 E-0306

title: Company aged-debt summary
requirement: ar_getAgedDebtSummary calls ar.usp_AgedDebtSummary with @CompanyCode and @AsOf only (no permission check), returning six company buckets and the accounts with items ordered by gross overdue; exposed because the API replaces the facade surface although only legacy tests call it (decision D-AR-04).
acceptance_criteria: buckets has six rows 0-5;accounts equals the procedure second result set;asOf 2000-01-01 returns the ledger rebuilt at that date

title: Customer Enquiry page
requirement: page:ar/customer-enquiry reproduces frmCustomerEnquiry: customer and as-at fields, 16-figure position panel, aged and items grids; F5/Find loads the enquiry then the ARENQ metrics (overriding seven figures only when RC <= 04, no dialog); F2 account list; Statement replaces the items grid; Credit check shows the decision line or the hold/error dialog; legacy texts, cues and money formatting kept (spec 3.2).
acceptance_criteria: keying c0001 and F5 shows C0001 with panel, grids and the status text "<n> open item(s) at <date>.  F2 account list, F5 refresh, F3 close.";a metrics RC 06 keeps the procedure figures and shows no dialog;Credit check on a held customer shows the hold dialog with the reason code and no decision line;DSO shows undefined when undefined, never 0

title: Credit check and release decision (CREDCHK CHECK)
requirement: ar_checkCustomerCredit links CREDCHK CHECK as DebtorsService.CreditCheck (check point default ORDER, currency default base currency, evaluation date = business date): exposure legs in sterling floored at 0, LastExposureGBP stored, BLOCK (RC 08 CRD0020-0022), HOLD (RC 06 CRD0030-0034 with a CREDIT exception for CREDMGR), release under override (RC 04 CRD0040) or RC 00 Credit available which discards an exposure error (spec 3.3, 4.5).
acceptance_criteria: TARCRED fixture gives exposure 1150.00, headroom -50.00, excess 50.00, utilisation 104.55 and 202 HOLD CRD0034;sanctions MATCH gives 422 BLOCK CRD0020 without consulting overrides;an approved in-date ORDER override covering the hold gives 200 WARNING CRD0040;each exposure computation fires ar.tr_CustomerCredit_Audit once

title: Credit override list
requirement: ar_listCreditOverrides runs the legacy override query over ar.CreditOverride for the company, filtered to the caller's own requests when requestsOnly is true (request mode or no AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE), newest first, with no business permission check (spec 3.3).
acceptance_criteria: SALESREP in request mode sees only own requests newest first;CREDMGR from the Debtors menu sees every override of the company

title: Credit override request (CREDCHK OVERRIDE)
requirement: ar_requestCreditOverride links CREDCHK OVERRIDE as DebtorsService.RequestCreditOverride: requester needs SO.ORDER.ENTER or AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE (RC 06 CRD0061), reason CRD0050, amount <= 0 replaced by the excess (CRD0051), scope and document CRD0057/CRD0058, validity AR.OVERRIDE.MAX.WORKDAYS (default 5) ENG business days, approval authority FIN.CONTROL.OVERRIDE above AR.OVERRIDE.FC.THRESHOLD (default 50000) else AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE, PENDING row and audit in CREDCHK own unit, RC 04 CRD0052 (spec 3.3, 4.6).
acceptance_criteria: workflow 5 step 2 (SALESREP, K0004, SOC900003, 7128.00) gives 200 WARNING CRD0052 naming AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE and a PENDING ORDER-scoped row valid for 5 ENG business days;a blank reason gives 422 CRD0050 and no row;50001.00 names FIN.CONTROL.OVERRIDE;a requester without either permission gets 202 and no row

title: Credit override independent approval (CREDCHK APPROVE)
requirement: ar_approveCreditOverride links CREDCHK APPROVE with the row customer, business date and override id: CRD0053 id 0, RC 16 CRD0056 not held, RC 06 CRD0054 self-approval, RC 08 CRD0060 not valid on the date, RC 06 CRD0061 authority from the stored amount, conditional PENDING update (RC 08 CRD0055 when no row), audit, RC 00 Credit override approved to dd/mm/yyyy (spec 3.3, 4.6).
acceptance_criteria: CREDMGR approving the workflow 5 request gives 200 RC 00 and an ACTIVE row approved by CREDMGR;the requester gets 202 CRD0054;a second approval gets 422 CRD0055;another customer code gets 404

title: Credit Overrides page (request and approval modes)
requirement: page:ar/credit-overrides reproduces frmCreditOverride for both menu rows: argument REQUEST disables approval and lists own requests; Debtors menu enables approval for AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE holders; request enabled for SO.ORDER.ENTER or AR.CREDIT.OVERRIDE; F10 requests in request mode and approves otherwise; legacy field limits, guard texts and status texts kept (spec 3.3).
acceptance_criteria: SALESREP from Sales sees Approve disabled and F10 submits a request;CREDMGR from Debtors sees the full list and F10 approves the selected row;blank customer, reference or reason shows the legacy warning without a call;the two menu rows open two separate windows

title: CREDCHK public in-process contract (IC-AR-CREDCHK)
requirement: CREDCHK is exposed to STERP-SO as an in-process contract with functions EXPOSURE, CHECK, RELEASE, OVERRIDE and APPROVE over CREDCHKCA on the caller unit of work: EXPOSURE/CHECK/RELEASE issue no BEGN so their writes join the caller transaction; OVERRIDE/APPROVE own their unit in autocommit and otherwise use savepoint CREDCHK (spec 3.3, 7.2.1).
acceptance_criteria: a caller rollback after a CHECK HOLD removes the LastExposureGBP update and the hold exception;a failing OVERRIDE inside a caller transaction rolls back only to savepoint CREDCHK;STERP-SO contract tests for IC-AR-CREDCHK pass

title: Allocatable items for a customer and currency
requirement: ar_getAllocatableItems calls ar.usp_OpenItemsForAllocation with @CompanyCode, @CustomerCode, @CurrencyCode only (no permission check, server date): debit items with discount availability and the AR.WRITEOFF.AUTO.GBP tolerance, credits/unapplied receipts/deposits, totals (spec 3.4).
acceptance_criteria: C0001 GBP returns SI-26-1001 with smallDifferenceToleranceGbp equal to the effective AR.WRITEOFF.AUTO.GBP (5.00 when unset);currency XXX gives 422 E-0305

title: Record a customer receipt (RCPTALOC RECEIPT)
requirement: ar_recordReceipt builds RCPTALOCCA as DebtorsService.NewReceipt and links RCPTALOC RECEIPT with the Idempotency-Key: RCP0001-0003 refusals, AR.RECEIPT.POST refusal RC 06 RCP0006 does not stop the posting, period RC 06 continues, idempotency replay RC 04 RCP0008, ARRC number, foreign receipts at parity (rate 0 -> 1), one unit writing ar.Receipt, the RECEIPT open item and the BANK/DEBTOR journal through ARPOSTGL (spec 3.4, 4.2).
acceptance_criteria: workflow 1 step 6 C0001 8196.00 to GBP1 gives 200 RC 00 Receipt <n> GBP 8,196.00 recorded (CONFIRMED) with one POSTED receipt, a -8196.00 RECEIPT item and a balanced GBP journal;a replay with the same key gives 200 RC 04 RCP0008 with the same number and no second receipt;gross 0 gives 422 RCP0002;a user without AR.RECEIPT.POST gets 202 HOLD RCP0006 and the receipt is recorded

title: Allocation residual preview (RCPTALOC PREVIEW)
requirement: ar_previewAllocation links RCPTALOC PREVIEW with the keyed receipt (or a named source) and 1-20 lines (apply, write-off, reason; no discount or conversion rate): AR.ALLOCATE.RUN, source rules, ordered line checks with the D-22 write-off authority (above AR.WRITEOFF.AUTO.GBP needs AR.WRITEOFF.APPROVE, else RC 06 RCP0029), classification and totals; nothing written, numbered or requested (spec 3.4, 4.3).
acceptance_criteria: C0001 8196.00 with a 4.00 write-off gives 200 RC 00 Preview only: 8,196.00 would be applied leaving 0.00 unapplied and totWriteoff 4.00;C0004 5081.00 with a 19.00 write-off by ARCLERK gives 202 HOLD RCP0029 and no row changes;no line gives 422 RCP0004

title: Allocate a receipt, credit or deposit (RCPTALOC ALLOCATE)
requirement: ar_allocateReceipt links RCPTALOC ALLOCATE with the named source returned by ar_recordReceipt and 1-20 lines: preview checks plus the period check, one unit writing ACTIVE allocations, target residuals and statuses, an adjustment journal (correlation <key 30>-ALLOC) when discount/write-off/FX totals are non-zero, and the source item and receipt totals; any stop RC 06-16 rolls back (spec 3.4, 4.3).
acceptance_criteria: the C0001 receipt applied to SI-26-1001 with a 4.00 write-off gives 200 RC 00, one ACTIVE WRITEOFF allocation, SI-26-1001 SETTLED at 0.00, a 4.00 BADDEBT/DEBTOR journal and receipt allocated 8196.00;the same with a 19.00 write-off by a user without AR.WRITEOFF.APPROVE gives 202 RCP0029 and no change;a source naming neither id nor document gives 404 RCP0023

title: Authorised allocation correction (RCPTALOC UNALLOC)
requirement: ar_unallocateAllocation links RCPTALOC UNALLOC with allocation id, reason and business date: AR.ALLOCATE.RUN (RC 06 stops), RCP0040/RCP0041, RC 16 RCP0042, RC 08 RCP0043, one unit inserting the contra allocation, reversing the original and restoring target and source residuals without touching the receipt, discount, write-off or FX and without a journal (spec 3.4, 4.4).
acceptance_criteria: an ACTIVE 150.00 allocation reversed gives a -150.00 contra row linked to it, the original REVERSED and both residuals restored;a second call gives 422 RCP0043;a blank reason gives 422 RCP0041;journalNo is blank

title: Receipt Entry page
requirement: page:ar/receipt-entry reproduces frmReceiptEntry: header fields and pickers, items grid with three editable columns, totals box; guards; at most 20 non-zero lines sent; preview RC 06 shown as a warning; F10 records the receipt then allocates with a new key (two units); correction prompt; abandon prompt; legacy status texts kept, including "The receipt was not recorded" after RC 06 (spec 3.4, 4.1).
acceptance_criteria: workflow 1 step 6 C0001 ends with "Receipt <n> posted; applied £8,196.00, unallocated cash £0.00." cue OK;the C0004 19.00 preview shows a warning with Reason code: RCP0029 and posts nothing;25 keyed lines send only the first 20;closing with keyed unposted amounts asks to abandon them

title: Credit-control worklist
requirement: ar_getCreditControlWorklist calls ar.usp_CreditControlWorklist with @CompanyCode, @UserCode and @OwnerUser (empty = all) and the facade defaults (no stage filter, suppressed excluded), returning the work items and the accounts; THROW 50301 gives 422 E-0301; stage filtering stays client-side (spec 3.5).
acceptance_criteria: items and accounts equal the two result sets in order with no suppressed item;ownerUser CREDMGR lists only items owned by CREDMGR

title: Raise a dispute (ARDISPUT DISPUTE)
requirement: ar_raiseDispute links ARDISPUT DISPUTE as DebtorsService.RaiseDispute: DSP0001-0005, RC 16 DSP0010/DSP0011, DSP0012 above residual + 0.004, AR.DISPUTE.RAISE refusal RC 06 DSP0060, ARCASE number, one unit amending or opening the case, flagging the item DISPUTED without changing the residual and adding a NOTE action, audit after commit, text cut to 256 characters (spec 3.5, 4.7).
acceptance_criteria: workflow 1 step 7 dispute on SI-26-1003/C0008 reason PRICE gives 200 RC 00, the item IsDisputed 1/DISPUTED with residual unchanged, an OPEN DISPUTE case and a NOTE action;an amount above the residual by more than 0.004 gives 422 DSP0012;a user without AR.DISPUTE.RAISE gets 202 DSP0060 and nothing written

title: Record a promise to pay (ARDISPUT PROMISE)
requirement: ar_recordPromiseToPay links ARDISPUT PROMISE as DebtorsService.RecordPromise (case reference from the worklist row, COLLECTION, PROMISE, business date, no item): DSP0006, DSP0020 before the business date, AR.COLLECTION.PROMISE refusal RC 06 DSP0060, new COLLECTION case when none, OPEN PROMISE action, follow-up one ENG business day after the promise date, each statement in autocommit (spec 3.5, 4.7).
acceptance_criteria: workflow 1 step 7 promise of 3000.00 for 2026-10-19 on the SI-26-1008/C0009 row gives promiseStatus OPEN and case next action date 2026-10-20;a promise dated before the business date gives 422 DSP0020;amount 0 gives 422 DSP0006

title: Credit Control Worklist page
requirement: page:ar/credit-control reproduces frmCreditControl: owner (menu argument) and stage picker with client-side StageCode filter, two grids, Raise dispute and Promise to pay prompts with the legacy defaults and texts (including the review-sweep sentence), report buttons opening the platform launcher for AGEDDEBT and DUNNING (spec 3.5).
acceptance_criteria: stage REMINDER2 shows only REMINDER2 items while accounts still show all of result set 2;reason code price is sent as PRICE;amount text abc is sent as 0 and the DSP0006 error dialog appears;report buttons open the launcher primed with AGEDDEBT or DUNNING

title: ARDEPOS customer deposit contract (IC-AR-ARDEPOS)
requirement: ARDEPOS functions DEPOSIT, ENQUIRE, APPLY and REFUND over ARDEPOSCA on the caller unit of work: DEPOSIT checks permission (RC 06 DEP0005 does not stop) and period, numbers DEP-<ARRC>, splits VAT, writes the negative DEPOSIT item, the AR.DEPOSIT journal and the CUSTOMERDEPOSIT VAT record between its own BEGN and COMT; APPLY and REFUND update sub-ledger rows only outside any unit (spec 3.6, 7.2.2).
acceptance_criteria: SOACCEPT DEPOSIT of 1200.00 at 20% writes one -1200.00 DEPOSIT item, a BANK 1200.00 / DEFERRED 1000.00 / VAT 200.00 journal and one VAT record, and its COMT commits the caller earlier statements;a user without AR.RECEIPT.POST still gets the deposit written and RC 06 DEP0005

title: ARINVPST sales invoice posting contract (IC-AR-ARINVPST)
requirement: ARINVPST functions VALIDATE, PROFORMA and POST over ARINVPSTCA on the caller unit of work: full invoice validation (ARI0001-ARI0042), POST stops on AR.INVOICE.POST refusal (RC 06 ARI0050) and on a replay (RC 04 ARI0051), continues on a period RC 06, numbers SINV and writes header, lines, VAT analysis, AR.INVOICE journal, VAT records, INVOICE open item and POSTED status in one BEGN..COMT (spec 3.6, 7.2.3).
acceptance_criteria: TARINV VALIDATE gives gross 1200.00 with one VAT line and due date 14/11/2026 and refuses a 260.00 simplified invoice with ARI0031;TARINV POST creates exactly one OPEN receivable of 1200.00, a journal number and 200.00 output VAT, and a replay returns RC 04 with the original number

title: ARCRNOTE sales credit note contract (IC-AR-ARCRNOTE)
requirement: ARCRNOTE functions CHECK and POST over ARCRNOTECA on the caller unit of work: credit validation and per-line/per-document creditable limits, POST continuing on RC 06 ARC0040/ARC0041 and period RC 06, stopping on ARC0042, replay ARC0043 and goodwill ARC0004, numbering SCRN and writing the credit, AR.CREDITNOTE journal, negative VAT records, CREDIT item and the original remaining creditable amount in one BEGN..COMT; provided for STERP-SO callers SOCREDIT/REBATE whose production use is open (decision D-AR-03) (spec 3.6, 7.2.4).
acceptance_criteria: TARGAP1 CHECK refusals give RC 08 ARC0003, ARC0005, ARC0002, ARC0006 and ARC0030 with no credit id and no writes;POST by a user without AR.CREDITNOTE.ENTER is committed and returns RC 06 ARC0040

title: ARPOSTGL sales-ledger posting adapter
requirement: ARPOSTGL ACCOUNT and POST over ARPOSTGLCA on the caller unit (no BEGN/COMT): validation GLP0001-0004, defaults, stage clearing, staging of value-bearing legs with map fill (GLP0005), GLP0006/GLP0007, EXEC fin.usp_PostJournal with the 14 legacy parameters through the platform gateway, GLP0011/GLP0008 mapping, and the legacy duplicate test on the fifth result column (PeriodNo, G09-ADV-18) reproduced (spec 3.6, 4.9).
acceptance_criteria: a balanced posting in fiscal period 7 gives RC 00 Journal <n> posted;the same in fiscal period 10 gives RC 04 GLP0009 although no journal existed (parity);unbalanced legs give RC 08 GLP0007 without calling the procedure;a procedure refusal gives RC 08 GLP0011 with its message

title: ARVATWRT VAT record writer
requirement: ARVATWRT LOOKUP and WRITE over ARVATWRTCA on the caller unit: active code and rate on the tax point (VAT0003/VAT0004), boxes by direction, defaults and YYYYQn period key, rate truncated to 4 then written with 2 decimals, no row when both sterling amounts are zero (spec 3.6).
acceptance_criteria: code S at 20% writes one fin.VatTransaction row with rate 20.00, the output boxes and period key 2026Q4 for tax point 2026-10-07;both sterling amounts zero gives RC 00 and no row;an unknown code gives RC 16 VAT0003

title: AGEDDEBT aged receivables report job
requirement: Job AGEDDEBT reproduces the program: CO, ASAT (system date default; outside 1990-2099 RC 8), CUST, USER; as-at residual rebuild, ageing, disputed/retired flags, footings, control-account comparison (RC 4 STERP-W-1901), Report Writer spool and STERP-I-SPOOL line; launched by catalogue rows AGEDDEBT and RPT-001, the menu, the credit-control toolbar and NIGHTLY (spec 3.7).
acceptance_criteria: for ASAT 20261007 the run RC and spool body equal the legacy run after normalization;ASAT 19891231 ends RC 8 with STERP-E-0101

title: STATEMNT customer statements job
requirement: Job STATEMNT reproduces the program: period FROM/TO (ASAT, system date), style from MODE or AR.STMT.STYLE, STYLE ignored, statement parties with suppression reasons, opening/lines/closing/ageing, STATEMENT actions on the COLLECTION case unless PREVIEW=Y (spec 3.7).
acceptance_criteria: no MODE uses AR.STMT.STYLE and inserts one STATEMENT action per produced or suppressed party;PREVIEW=Y writes no case or action;FROM after TO ends RC 8

title: DUNNING collection reminders and letters job
requirement: Job DUNNING reproduces the program: CO, ASAT, MODE (PREVIEW default, COMMIT, else RC 8), STAGE/OWNER ignored; per-customer worklist, step by oldest overdue age (7/21/30/45/75), suppression reasons, letters in both modes, escalation exceptions, COMMIT case/action/item updates (spec 3.7).

title: DDCOLL Direct Debit collection job

title: Legacy conversion load job CONVLOAD (XMD.CONVLOAD)
requirement: Job CONVLOAD loads one fixed-width extract (FILE default data\legacy\CALAROPN.DAT, relative to the legacy application root) at CUTOVER (default ASAT; XMD.CONV.CUTOVER not read): batch reference CONV-<base name>-<cutover> in 40 bytes; COMMIT merges stg.ImportBatch (reopened OPEN/COMMIT) in autocommit and opens one unit of work; lines (blank skipped) are sorted by type, 60-byte natural key and arrival (ordinal); per record in order: type and field validation with the legacy reason texts, in-file duplicate of the previous sorted record, restart test (VALID processed stg.ImportRow of this batch: LOADED, not posted or rewritten), ledger duplicate, COMMIT posting of AR/AP open items at the cut over (FX from core.FxRate else 1, GBP rounded by SQL Server, CREDIT only for kind CR), opening stock through ITM STKMOVE OPENING on the same unit of work (correlation CVL|base|cutover|sequence; RC < 8 posted, SM-DUPLICATE gives DUPLICATE, RC 8 rejected RC >= 4, RC > 8 rejected RC 12) and fin.OpeningBalance rows, and the stg.ImportRow MERGE; trial-balance proof |DR - CR| > 0.004 gives RC 8 and an ERROR CONVERSION DIFFERENCE exception inside the unit; rejections or duplicates RC >= 4; RC > 4 rolls back else commits; the batch is then updated with counts and PARTIAL or COMMITTED even after a rollback; PREVIEW validates and reports only; spool FL-066.
acceptance_criteria: Given CO=CAL FILE=data\legacy\CALAROPN.DAT CUTOVER=20260331 MODE=PREVIEW (demo workflow 4 step 2) then the 8 records are listed in sorted order with 4 ACCEPTED (SC-900104 as a credit), 1 DUPLICATE 'The same key appears earlier in the file', 3 REJECTED (not a real calendar date, amount not numeric, customer not on file), RC 4 and only core.JobRun written;Given the same with MODE=COMMIT on a state without the batch and documents then 8 stg.ImportRow rows (4 VALID 3 INVALID 1 DUPLICATE), 4 ar.OpenItem rows at 20260331 (SI-900101 original = residual = 12450.00 OPEN), batch CONV-CALAROPN-20260331 PARTIAL 8/4/3/1 and RC 4;Given the same COMMIT again then the four accepted records are LOADED, no staging row is added and no second set of open items exists;Given CALGLTB.DAT in COMMIT then the accepted lines must prove within 0.004 or the whole load rolls back with RC 8;Given another company's extract loaded into STC then nothing is accepted

title: Legacy conversion extract format FL-067
requirement: The conversion input is a line-sequential file of 130-byte records read byte for byte: bytes 1-4 record type; AROP/APOP party 5-14, document number 15-24, kind 25-26, document date 27-34, due date 35-42, currency 43-45, amount 46-60, terms 61-70, reference 71-80; STKB site 5-14, warehouse 15-24, item 25-64, revision 65-69 (first 4 used), lot 70-79, quantity 80-94, unit cost 95-109, location 110-119; GLTB account 5-16, balance date 17-24, debit 25-39, credit 40-54, narrative 55-84, cost centre 85-94; natural key bytes 5-24 (STKB 5-24 + 25-64); shorter lines space-padded, blank lines skipped; dates valid when numeric, >= 19000101 and TEST-DATE-YYYYMMDD = 0; amounts pass when non-blank and the first 20 characters are spaces, -, +, ., comma or digits, then NUMVAL to 2 decimals (truncation). Over-long lines: [UNKNOWN: GnuCOBOL 3.2 line-sequential handling], truncated to 130 pending confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given each demo extract (CALAROPN, CALAPOPN, CALGLTB, CALSTOCK) then the parsed type, key, field values and sequence equal the legacy CONVLOAD listing;Given the CALAROPN line for SI-900107 then the amount text is ABC12.X0 and the record is rejected 'Amount is not numeric in the extract';Given a blank line then it is neither counted nor listed;Given a line longer than 130 bytes then it is truncated to 130 (to be confirmed)

acceptance_criteria: Given the demo fixture and CO=STC JOB=CST27000 Then one contract block with CST27000, CST27001 (EAC 31,727.00 above budget 31,000.00 flagged *** forecast over budget) and CST27002 and exit code 0;Given MODE=OVERSPEND Then only jobs whose EAC exceeds a non-zero budget are printed;Given the procedure fails Then exit 12 with STERP-E-1001 and the spool still closed and announced

title: Job CSTVARRP - variance analysis by type and owner (CSTRP030)
requirement: Job CSTVARRP: parameters CO (STC), USER (COST), MODE (ALL; UNDISPOSED omits rows with a disposal), PERIOD (yyyynn split by position, blank = all), TYPE, JOB, ITEM; JOBLOG START; spool; cst.Variance rows of the company with the optional filters ordered by type, year, period, id; rows with subject, document, period, quantity, rate and total variance, sense and owner; type groups with 11 long names (else Other) and totals; final adverse, favourable, net, rows and unexplained count and value; rows without owner and disposal flagged UNEXPLAINED and RC 4; JOBLOG END rejected; exit 0, 4 or 12; read-only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the demo fixture and CO=STC Then seven variance rows grouped by type with the LANDED row LC270620 flagged UNEXPLAINED and exit code 4;Given MODE=UNDISPOSED Then rows with a disposal are omitted

title: Job CSTSETCM - cost set comparison and revaluation impact (CSTRP040)
requirement: Job CSTSETCM: parameters CO (STC), USER (COST), MODE (ALL; EXCEPTION omits UNDER lines), COSTSET (required, RC 12 STERP-E-0151; must exist, RC 12 STERP-E-0152), COMPARETO (else ComparedToSetCode, else latest ACTIVE STANDARD set other than the proposal; none RC 12 STERP-E-0153; not found RC 12 STERP-E-0154), THRESHOLD (default 5, also when 0); JOBLOG START before validation; spool; FULL JOIN of the two sets on item and revision with NEW, DROPPED, BOTH, previous and proposed cost and summed quantity on hand; change, percent ROUNDED 2 dp, impact ROUNDED; bands NEW, DROPPED, AT OR OVER, UNDER with subtotals and final totals; console lines; JOBLOG END rejected; exit 0 or 12; read-only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the demo fixture and CO=STC COSTSET=FY2027STD Then the comparison is against FY2026STD with one line in each band (two items over 5 percent, one under, BATTERY-36V-14AH NEW, BB-SHELL-BSA68 DROPPED) and exit code 0;Given no COSTSET Then exit 12 with STERP-E-0151

title: Job CSTWIPRF - WIP roll-forward and period posting (CSTRP050)
requirement: Job CSTWIPRF: parameters CO (STC), USER (COST), MODE (CALC; only the literal POST posts), PERIOD (yyyynn split without validation; blank reads core.FiscalPeriod, which the repository does not define, so the legacy no-open-period path STERP-W-0151 with year and period 0 is reproduced), JOB; JOBLOG START; spool; jobs of the company not financially CLOSED (or the one JOB) ordered by FinancialStatus, JobRef; per job WIPCALC CALC or POST with the reference cut to 14 characters; refused jobs omitted with STERP-W-1101; two lines per job, status bands, final footing, console lines; JOBLOG END rejected; exit 0 or 12. MODE=POST updates cst.WipBalance, else inserts it, statement by statement in autocommit. Job-list continuation reproduces the inferred legacy rule: the list ends after the first job whose WIPCALC call executed SQL on SQLIO slot 1 (refusals before SQL do not end it) until the legacy oracle confirms (U-CST-01, BC-CST-04).
acceptance_criteria: Given the demo fixture and CO=STC PERIOD=202607 MODE=CALC Then the first non-closed job in FinancialStatus, JobRef order is printed with opening 33,985.00 = closing 33,985.00, nothing is written and the exit code is 0;Given MODE=POST PERIOD=202607 JOB=CST27000 Then one cst.WipBalance row for CST27000 2026/07 with closing 33,985.00 is inserted or updated and committed immediately;Given PERIOD blank Then STERP-W-0151 is displayed, every job is refused with CST0903, no job lines are printed and the exit code is 0;Given MODE=PREVIEW or post in lower case Then nothing is written

title: Costing master data through the platform generic maintenance page
requirement: The five CST core.MaintDef rows and their 50 core.MaintCol rows are served unchanged by the platform generic maintenance page and procedures: CST.ELEMENT cst.CostElement (not company-scoped), CST.POLICY cst.CostPolicy, CST.RATES cst.WorkCentre (retire column IsActive), CST.LANDED cst.LandedCost, CST.NRV cst.Impairment, gated by CST.RATE.MAINT, CST.LANDED.MAINT and CST.NRV.POST. CST adds no code; platform saves are co-writers of these tables inside core.usp_UiMaintSave's own transaction and the CST CHECK constraints refuse invalid values as in legacy.
acceptance_criteria: Given Costing > Work Centre Rates Then the platform page lists cst.WorkCentre for the session company with the 13 seeded columns and retires rows through IsActive;Given a cost policy saved with method LIFO Then the save is refused by CK_CstPol_M and nothing is written

title: Costing engine conventions (kernel of the CST components)
requirement: Every implemented CST COBOL function keeps its program conventions: per-call reset of the header and outputs, in-place upper-casing and defaulting before validation, validation in coded order with the first refusal winning (RC 08, message count + 1), last-writer-wins reason codes where coded, SQL failure as RC 12 CST9001 with the first 200 characters of the driver message and no rollback, RC 16 for not found, truncation to the receiving scale unless ROUNDED (half away from zero) is coded; COMMAREA input normalization of contracts 4.4; no WORKING-STORAGE carried between requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given an SQL failure inside a COBOL-backed operation Then 500 severe with returnCode 12, reasonCode CST9001 and the driver message as detail;Given two refusal conditions in one request Then only the first in coded order is reported;Given input with more decimals than the COMMAREA field Then it is rounded half away from zero at the boundary and results are truncated where the code has no ROUNDED
